messages:
maria: quick FYI — I want to roll out a runtime feature gate 'route_safety_v2' that changes routing policy precedence + per-tenant quota smoothing. planning a staged rollout tomorrow.
sahil: +1. can we do percentage-based traffic split? start at 1% for 30m then 5% then 20%.
trent: prefer sticky canary routing for stateful sessions. if we only do random sampling we might blow up KV cache miss profile.
maria: good call. plan was: sticky for tenants with >5k req/day, else random. also add an explicit kill-switch in config.
olivia: console UX question — can we expose rollout progress in the rollout modal (steps, %progress, failures)? product asked for a one-click rollback.
maria: yes — we should show progress + recent regressions (failed_requests_rate, latency_p50/p95, model_fallback_rate).
kevin: audit + auth: make sure the rollout change is recorded in the audit log and gated by the config-change permission. also who's signing off? security wants CMK key id in the change metadata.
maria: noted. we'll attach requestor and key_id.
trent: technical: how are we going to apply the config? in-memory dynamic patch vs restart? dynamic is safer for speed but we need validation to avoid bad states.
sahil: dynamic + schema validation + dry-run mode. run dry-run on 100% of logs to compare decisions, not applied. then apply to canary.
maria: draft of the runtime patch API I was thinking:

```
PATCH /v1/runtime/config
{
  "gate": "route_safety_v2",
  "rules": [
    {"id":"sticky-tenants","match":"tenant.request_rate > 5000","route":"canary","stickiness":"session_id"},
    {"id":"default-sample","sample_pct":1,"route":"canary"}
  ],
  "kill_switch_path":"/v1/runtime/config/gates/route_safety_v2/off",
  "dry_run": true
}
```

trent: i don't love exposing kill_switch as a path — maybe a separate control plane endpoint that triggers immediate revert. reduces accidental misuse.
kevin: agree — make kill switch require two-person approval if hitting prod.
olivia: for console: show a big red revert button only to owners + ops. show a diff view from previous gate.
sahil: telemetry: emit these metrics during rollout: rollout.progress{gate,step}, rollout.dryrun_mismatch_rate, rollout.failed_requests_rate, rollout.latency_p95_delta.
maria: yes. also emit config.change event with before/after hashes.
kevin: storage: store the config blobs in the encrypted config store (versioned). add checksum and signer metadata.
trent: can we add a safety gate that automatically halts rollout if failed_requests_rate > 0.5% for >5m? auto-pause on regressions.
sahil: yes, add an automated policy: metrics-based abort + a cooldown backoff of 1h before restarting.
maria: sounds good. small debate: where to evaluate metric policies? local node-level vs central controller? central controller easier to reason about but adds single-point-of-failure.
trent: central controller with local fallback is best: controller decides, nodes enforce locally and can fallback to old config if heartbeat lost.
olivia: product asks for a visual timeline and an exported CSV of rollout events for audits.
kevin: we'll add audit events to S3 and to the internal event bus. ensure retention policy aligns with compliance.
maria: deploy-bot — quick safety check for tomorrow's rollout window?
deploy-bot: runbook check: window open 2026-03-19T02:00Z-04:00Z. dependency check passed. alerting configured: #prod-alerts + pager on-call. dry-run path enabled.
trent: action items: (1) schema + validation (trent), (2) backend dynamic apply + kill-switch (sahil), (3) console UI + diff (olivia), (4) audit + kms metadata (kevin), (5) telemetry + abort-policy (maria).
sahil: i'll prototype the controller circuit-breaker logic today.
maria: i'll queue the dry-run change for tomorrow in staging. tagging @ops for FYI :eyes:
olivia: will mock the UI in Fig tomorrow morning.
kevin: i'll draft the audit retention policy and 2-person approval flow.
maria: thanks all. if no objections by EOD i'll proceed with the staged plan. :thumbsup:
